name: TemplateCompiler
purpose: Define one compiler, artifact and program contract followed by every core language.

CompileMode.invariant: Selects the compiled program representation only.

ArtifactRefresh.invariant: Controls build artifact regeneration independently of compile mode.

SourceGraph.invariant: Contains normalized UTF-8 sources before parsing and is never read by a deployed false-refresh program.

TypeManifest.invariant: Types, host function signatures and fixed definition targets are explicit compiler inputs.

TypedProgram.invariant: All symbols, paths, expression types, function calls and block inputs are resolved before artifact emission.

ArtifactManifest.invariant: Digests bind the artifact to its complete sources, types and compiler contract.

RenderRequest.invariant: assign is root data and define is the template registry; both modes receive the same normalized values.

Program.invariant: AstProgram and GeneratedProgram are disjoint peer implementations with identical observable behavior.

AstProgram.operation: Interpret a precompiled canonical AST without parsing during render.

GeneratedProgram.operation: Call generated template functions directly without retaining a parser or AST interpreter.

RuntimeBindings.invariant: AST evaluation and generated code share the same language-specific value and error semantics.

FunctionSignature.invariant: Built-in and host signatures are checked before artifact emission; implementations are resolved at program load.

DefinitionData<T>.fields: one presence-preserving optional field for every Input<T> field
DefinitionData<T>.invariant: An absent field does not overwrite assign; a present nullable field carries null.

Definition<T>.invariant: html bypasses template execution; data has the fixed DefinitionData<T> type of the declared target.

Definitions.fields: one optional Definition<T> field for every declared define key
Definitions.invariant: Generated code cannot select a target absent from the manifest.

Input<T>.fields: the fields declared for template T
Input<T>.invariant: Block input precedence is assign, definition.data, then block scope.

forbidden: parsing or code generation during render
